pr_title: Check the version of the default cgroup mountpoint
pr_body:
##### Summary
The PR adds an additional check for the default cgroup mount point. It's a stopgap that fixes incorrect detection of cgroups v1, when `default-hierarchy=hybrid` but only a cgroups v2 hierarchy is mounted.

Fixes #11094

##### Component Name
cgroups plugin

##### Test Plan
Run Netdata with cgroups v2 mounted on `/sys/fs/cgroup` and `default-hierarchy=hybrid`. Unified cgroups should be enabled and working.
pr_comments:
Looks good. Thanks for the fix @vlvkobal !

Tested when Netdata installed directly on a host and as a docker container - Cgroup v2 detection works in both cases!

comments: Here is a quick and dirty fix - #11102. We should rewrite cgroups plugin, though. It should support hybrid cgroup configurations and do correct detection based on mountpoints - no loose magic.
